decisions.reason: A niche agricultural crate that is only mentioned on the website gives limited evidence of traction, but at this low cost it has not yet shown the clear shortfall against aspirations that would trigger search, and the large firm's slack lets it carry the product.
A foldable large container with its own page fits the firm's core automotive and industrial returnable business, and its strong visibility suggests results near the aspiration level.
A standard stackable crate that is only mentioned is easy to keep in a broad catalogue, and its low incremental cost gives little reason to drop it within one year.
A medium-duty rackable pallet completes the pallet range for industrial and pooling customers, and with no evidence of underperformance the firm will likely keep it while results remain uncertain.
A spill-retention pallet with its own page serves a specialised hygiene and safety need, and the visible promotion signals management commitment while results are still forming.
A pallet with load retainers presented on its own page builds on the firm's core pallet expertise, and organisational slack allows it time to reach aspiration levels.
